title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30358: add OnBeforeOnPreReport event to Redraw Receivable Bills report
summary: Adds an OnBeforeOnPreReport integration event to the ES Redraw Receivable Bills report (7000096). Extensions can set the request page variables and, through IsHandled, skip the NewDueDate and journal batch validations so the report can run unattended, for example from a job queue.
key_points: New OnBeforeOnPreReport integration event fires at the start of OnPreReport trigger
Event exposes request page variables and IsHandled flag by reference
Allows extensions to bypass NewDueDate and journal batch validations for automation
Enables unattended report execution via job queue or buttons without GUI
IsHandled flag initialized to false, controlled by subscribers
